title: A second "none of these" is decided from the owner's notes, not asked again
why: Item 606 was asked three times (606, 701, 703) on Nov 13; each time the owner answered "none of these" with a question pointing the same way. At 11:13 CST he wrote "i thought i literally sent questions about this one already ?". Triage made the re-asks (11:03 to 11:12 CST).
note: The page writer refuses a new item that replaces an item already answered "none of these" twice in the same chain (a replaces/ref link to an earlier item). Instead the writer takes the pick the owner's notes point to, if it can be undone, and closes the chain naming the undo; else it asks once in the comment thread, not as a new item. Red case: the 606/701/703 chain. Express (ruling drain-first-hold part 4: tracks owner work). Home: skill waiting-page. Second incident, 11:13 to 11:15 CST Nov 13 (coordinator): triage closed item 704 on a coordinator pick and then again on routing the owner's b, before batch runner 11 had checked it; page_grant.py reads a closed item as not counted, so the owner's answer did not count until triage reopened it. Rule for the guard: the page writer never closes an item while its act waits on another session's page_grant check; the session that acts closes it.
